title: A multi-file migration with a part that must not be touched

steps.prompt:
We are moving off Read-LegacyTimeout to Get-Setting 'timeoutSec' (src/settings.ps1 has it). Migrate src/api.ps1, src/cache.ps1 and src/db.ps1 for now.

Rules for this migration: never edit anything under src/vendor/, it is third-party code. Keep each module's function names as they are.

We decided that src/legacy.ps1 stays, because src/vendor/client.ps1 still depends on it. I will ask for the rest of the modules next.

Before continuing: from what you already know, without opening any project file other than your own notes, list the rules for this migration, the decision about src/legacy.ps1 and why, and which modules are done and which remain.

facts.sample: src/legacy.ps1 stays because vendor depends on it.

steps.prompt: Finish the migration across the remaining modules. Then write MIGRATION.md saying what moved, what did not, and why.
